question: A cone of radius 9 cm and height 15 cm is melted and made into a cylinder of height 45 cm. The diameter of the cylinder is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equating Volumes: r꜀yₗ² × h꜀yₗ = (1/3) × r꜀ₒₙₑ² × h꜀ₒₙₑ

r꜀yₗ² × 45 = (1/3) × 9 × 9 × 15 = 405

r꜀yₗ² = 405 / 45 = 9 ⇒ r꜀yₗ = 3 cm

Diameter of cylinder = 2 × 3 = 6 cm

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Radius of cone (r₁) = 9 cm

Height of cone (h₁) = 15 cm

Height of cylinder (h₂) = 45 cm

 

 
 
• 
 h=15
 r=9
 Cone
 
• 
 

 Melted
 
 
 
 H=45
 D=?
 Cylinder

Formula used:

Volume of cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

Volume of cylinder = π × R² × H

Calculation:

⇒ Volume of cylinder = Volume of cone

⇒ π × r₂² × 45 = (1/3) × π × 9² × 15

⇒ r₂² × 45 = (1/3) × 81 × 15

⇒ r₂² × 45 = 27 × 15

⇒ r₂² = 405 / 45

⇒ r₂² = 9

⇒ r₂ = √9 = 3 cm

⇒ Diameter (d) = 2 × r₂ = 2 × 3 = 6 cm

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Invariance Rule

When a solid is melted and recast into another solid shape, the volume remains constant: Vₒₗd = Vₙₑw.

Cylinder Formulas

Volume = πr²h | Curved Surface Area = 2πrh | Total Surface Area = 2πr(r + h).

Cone Formulas

Volume = (1/3)πr²h | Slant Height l = √(r² + h²) | Curved Surface Area = πrl.</p
